messages:
amanda: quick note — /v1/generate curl example has "request_id" in the JSON body, but our OpenAPI and runtime expect X-Request-Id as a header.
kevin: thanks, that mismatch will break codegen. can you paste the current curl snippet?
amanda: curl on page: curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-2-mini","prompt":"hi","request_id":"abc-123"}'
lucas: we should standardize on header. python SDK accepts request_id param and maps to the header — add a note showing the mapping.
sarah_p: i'll scan rerank and stream pages for copy/paste examples with request_id in body.
jordan: i'll open a small docs PR to: remove request_id from example bodies, add X-Request-Id header examples across generate/stream/rerank, and annotate SDK snippets. tagging reviewers.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5621 — CI: docs build OK, linkcheck flagged one anchor (fixing in PR).
amanda: great, will review later today. if you find other occurrences drop file paths here and i'll add to the PR checklist. :thumbsup:
